structured_output.what_is_happening: A 17-minute-old pump.fun coin, "Memetically-Engineered Product" (m/ep), is still on the bonding curve at about $19.6k market cap. It is up about 410% in its first hour, including +59% to +81% in the last 5 minutes, on $47k volume. That is about 2.7x its market cap. Breadth is fairly wide for its age: 365 unique buyers against 295 unique sellers. Price is already about 20% below its ATH of 2.449e-5. The dev has sold everything (creator_close), and the coin is flagged as a community takeover. Its only social link is a single X post by @CookedSupermann.

narrative.description: The name suggests an ironic, meta, AI-flavoured idea ('memetically engineered product'), probably drawn from one X post. It has no website, Telegram or description. The story is vague and depends on whoever wrote or shared that post.
narrative.why_spreading: Likely early pump.fun momentum trading on a clever name and a tweet reference. Four smart wallets and one renowned (KOL) wallet are present, but there are no smart-money signals or degen calls.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the only pair found, and the linked X post is presumably where the phrase comes from. We can't tell whether that post's author endorses the token.

authenticity.evidence: Buyer breadth is real: 365 unique buyers and 553 buys. The fresh-wallet rate is low (8%) and the sniper hold rate is modest (12%). But GMGN tags 133 bundler wallets, top bundler traders hold 32%, and the bot/degen rate is 39%. There are no paid boosts. The dev sold out and a CTO label was added very quickly.
authenticity.uncertainty: GMGN's bundler tagging on curve coins is noisy. The high unique-seller count (295) means a lot of fast flipping.

structural_risks: Top bundler traders hold 32% and could dump into the curve
GeckoTerminal shows top-10 at 66%, but that likely includes the curve account
Price is already about 20% off ATH after a 5x in 17 minutes
The curve is about 63% complete, so migration is a volatile point

structured_output.counterargument: Breadth is strong for a 17-minute-old coin, momentum in the last 5 minutes is still accelerating, and there's no paid promotion. A 2x from about $20k only needs $40k. The coin could reach that on the way to completing its bonding curve (~$60k+) if the tweet spreads. On the other side, the bundle cluster and the flippers who already made 5x could easily cause a -50% drop before any 2x.

structured_output.thesis: This is an early momentum coin with good buyer breadth and a clever meta name. It is also bundler-heavy, the dev has exited, and it is entering after a 5x. It has a somewhat better-than-average chance of reaching its bonding-curve completion (migration) move, but a pullback of -50% or more from an extended entry is at least as likely.
